(361)༈mkhas grub karma chags med kyi lo yag cho ga snying por dril ba bzhugs so/ /༈na mo gu ra we/bcas rnams gzhung ltar tshogs nas/hūm̐/'og min chos ka

tei:div.tei:p: ༈ mkhas grub karma chags med kyi lo yag cho ga snying por dril ba bzhugs so// ༈ na mo gu ra we/ bcas rnams gzhung ltar tshogs nas/ hūm̐/ 'og min chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang nas/ sangs rgyas rin chen yon tan rgya mtsho yi/ baiḍūrya dang gser gyi kha dog bzang*/ gser du snang ba'i dpal zhes bcu gsum bcas/ lha mo dpal chen ma yi bshes gnyen khyod/ gshegs dang bzhugs pa'i mtshan ma mi mnga' yang*/ chu zla bzhin du gnas 'dir snang bar mdzod/ mngon par dga' sogs dag pa'i zhing khams nas/ byang chub sems dpa' sa snying gshegs su gsol/ lcang lo can sogs rgyal po'i pho brang nas/ dpal dang nor rgyun lha mo gshegs su gsol/ 'og gzhi dbang chen gser gyi dkyil 'khor nas/ sa yi lha mo 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kṣiḥhi rā dza dāe bi shrī ba su dha ri pri thi dāe bi sa pā ri ba ra badzra sa ma ya dzaḥ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen me tog gi yon tan rgya mtsho baiḍūrya(362)dang gser gyi ri kha dog bzang po gser du snang ba'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po rgyal po la= byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sa yi snying po la= lha mo dpal chen mo la= 'phags ma lha mo nor rgyun ma la= sa yi lha mo brtan ma'i mthus bdag gi zhing khams thams cad du sa yi bcud 'phel bar gyur cig gser gyi sa gzhi gling gzhi gling phran bcas// gser gyi ri bdun ri rab rgyal srid bdun// nyer spyod sna bdun gzugs sgra dri ro reg /lnga phrag lnga dang bkra shis rdzas rtags brgyad// dngos su 'byor dang yid las sprul pa'i tshogs// 'jig rten 'di'am 'jig rten gzhan dag na// ma rmos lo tog lha yi bdud rtsi dang*// dpag bsam ljon shing dar zab lha yi gos// rin chen ri bo gser gyi bye ma dang*/

khrus kyi rdzing bu yan lag brgyad ldan chu// blo yis blangs te mchod pa'i rdzas su dmigs// khyad par bdag dang bdag gi bsrung bya yi// ri zhing thang zhing sa bon ljang bu dang*// snye ma (363)'bru dang bcas pa mcho pa dang*// rin chen snod du dkar gsum bdud rtsi'i mtsho/ kha dog dri ro nus pa phun tshogs 'bul/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kṣiṃ hi rā dza dāe bi shrī ba su dha ri pri thi dāe bī sa pa ri wa ra i dam ba ling ta kha kha hiḥ arghaṃ sogs nas shabta sarba pū dza pra titstsha swā hā/ 'das pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs// rin chen me tog yon tan rgya mtsho mi/ baiḍūrya dang gser ri kha dog bzang*// gser du snang ba'i dpal la phyag 'tshal bstod// gang zhig zhing ni bzang ngam ngan yang rung*// sa bon btab nas so nam ma byas kyang*/ khyed la mchod cing rtse gcig gsol btab nas// lo thog 'bru rnams 'phel mdzad thugs rje can// sa yi snying po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ mtshan tsam thos pas bde skyid lo legs shing*// gnod byed sha za srin pos gnod mi nus// nad dang mu ges 'chi ba zhi mdzad ma// lha mo nor rgyun ma la= skye ba kun tu ngan song skye sgo 'gog /tshe rabs kun tu lha mi'i bde skyid spyod// tshe (364)'dir zas gos longs spyod kun stsol ma// lha mo dpal chen mo la= gang zhig skal bzang rgyal ba thams cad kyi// sa lam bgrod cing mngon par sangs rgyas pa'i// dpang por bdud dpung 'joms mdzad mthu mo che// sa yi lha mo brtan ma= lha mo dpal chen ma la grogs mo brgyad// zla shel ma dang sbyin byed rab sbyin ma// 'phags ma sbas ma lha mo rab bzang ma// dbyangs can ma sogs 'khor dang bcas la bstod// bdag gi thugs nas 'od 'phros mdun skyed bskul// mdun skyed thugs srog sngags kyi 'od zer gyis// 'jig rten kun gyi sa bcud 'od ser po'i// rnam par bsdus nas zhing la thim par gyur// oṃ kṣi hi rā dza ye swā hā/

oṃ āḥkṣi ti garbhe thi lhaṃ hūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ ba su dha ri ṇye swā hā/ oṃ dhe bi shrī ye swā hā/ oṃ pri thī dhe bi swā hā/ de rnams brgya re bzla/ 'di ltar mchod bstod bgyis pa'i dge ba des// bdag sogs gang du gnas pa'i sa phyogs= sogs rjod/ mkhas grub karma chags med rin po che'i lo yag chog gzhung tshar gcig gi 'phros su grangs (365) gsog 'di kho na btang na phun sum tshogs par yod do/ zhes ma ṇis so/ / 'dzam bu gling gi rgyal mtshan gser bzang po// shākya thub pa dam chos gser gyi 'od/ sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' sa yi snying*// dpal dang nor rgyun ma dang grogs mo brgyad// sa yi lha mo sa bdag tshogs rnams la/ phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul lo legs dngos grub stsol// dgos ched sna tshogs kyi phyir rgyal khams kyi snyom las pa padma ma ṇir 'bod pas bkod do/ yi ge pa ni nyi sras so// sarba maṅga laṃ// dge'o//
